pages.text: Drops a field for 15 seconds that destroys every projectile inside it that isn't yours or your patrol's, and hands everyone inside Absorption IV on top of it. Archers on a wall stop being the problem, and a thrown trident just drops to the ground.$(br2)Cooldown is 45 seconds, and firing any Raidborn totem puts all three on it.
pages.title: Totem of Resistance
